summary: Analyze Tecan kinetic and endpoint exports with intended concentration grouping and documented well exclusions.
notes: The normal Plate Reader Analysis window accepts Tecan Infinite i-control XLSX fluorescence data. Select the acquisition worksheet explicitly when several measurement sheets exist; gain and worksheet provenance are retained and different gains are never combined or normalized.

Kinetic imports preserve fractional elapsed times and cycle temperatures. Endpoint grids become one timepoint. Missing, invalid, formula-based or over-range readings block the selected acquisition instead of being replaced with zeros or silently dropped.

Grouping & Exclusions proposes declared targets from experiment_design.json unless saved experiment analysis settings exist. Review intended levels and matching tolerance, initially 2%. Every keyed concentration must match exactly one intended level; unmatched, ambiguous or malformed saved settings block analysis.

Manual well and range exclusions require reasons and apply to all channels and timepoints before analytical calculations and outlier baselines. Reports and ZIP exports retain settings, raw readings, calculated-to-intended mappings, per-well audit, excluded-well QC and remaining replicate counts. Conditions with fewer than three replicates have limited replicate-based outlier detection.

The supplied kinetic and unsaturated endpoint acquisitions passed complete analysis and ZIP export. All 1,664 readings matched independent inspection and source hashes were unchanged. Excluding N1:P4 leaves 48 keyed wells across 15 conditions; MM groups at 1 mM and pSTOPv2 at 1.25, 2.5 and 5 nM. The Windows no-hardware simulation was accepted by the operator.

Firmware artifact bytes, protocol, runtime dependency declarations, canonical machine-data schema, execution-calibration version 4 and execution-data capabilities are identical to v1.3.3. No firmware flash is required solely for this application update; existing provenance and SAFE requirements remain enforced.

Retains the three exact stable legacy migration cohorts and pinned rc.11 discovery route. Automatic rollback remains unconfigured; preserve measurements, committed counts, progress and immutable revisions and use protected current-version or exactly qualified compatible-bundle recovery.
See docs/v1.3.4_release_qualification.md for validation, limitations and publication order. Existing large-optimizer and long-session timing limitations remain unchanged.
validation: 148 focused parser, association, grouping, exclusions, Qt settings/window, worker-subprocess, report and export tests passed
Complete supplied-data kinetic and endpoint analyses and ZIP exports passed; all 1,664 raw readings matched independent inspection and original source hashes were unchanged

Required release gate: full Windows suite with --run-analysis-pipeline on the committed metadata revision; external run.json, pytest.log, junit.xml and qualification receipt retain exact counts and outcomes
Full-suite coverage includes updater request/UI/backend, release metadata, packaging, execution-data rollback, immutable legacy discovery and stable bootstrap preservation/refusal
tools/validate_release_metadata.py, strict release JSON parsing and git diff --check; tools/validate_release_metadata.py --check-tags only after separately authorized tag creation
